What the inputs show

Percentages have different denominators: neighbourhood area, households or residents. The case-study route measure is separate from official household access.

How priorities respond to weights

Rank ranges are 5th–95th percentiles across tested weights, not confidence intervals. Stability does not certify source quality.

Reading the map. Scales remain fixed across borough and search filters. Composite scores compare the same complete-evidence cohort; grey composite areas are unassessed. Raw inputs can remain visible where no composite score is assigned.

Portfolio study · simulated commission, not an official Greater Manchester assessment. Sources span 2021–2026 and do not describe one common observation date. Flooding covers the selected river/sea scenario, not surface-water flooding. Satellite heat describes the land surface. Walking access is modelled, not field verified.
